notices: Curated snapshot reviewed 2026-10-27, not live telemetry. Refreshing this page does not refresh review time, chain state, capacity or execution readiness.

Implemented means a scoped consumer exists, not that every listed variant is proven, funded, profitable or executable now. Source review, tests, quote probes, mined legs and completed conditional forks are different evidence classes; evidence does not transfer between adapters.

Capacity and execution are independent unknowns unless explicit scoped evidence says otherwise. Unknown is not zero. No current capacity refresh or all-cost-positive executable liquidation is established here.

The general promotion threshold is conservative net > 0 after obligations, acquisition, unwind, fees, slippage, gas, financing, latency/competition and uncertainty haircuts. The separate competitive rehearsal pilot now uses a 1 raw USDC (0.000001 USDC) net floor, superseding its historical 100 USDC floor; that pilot-specific floor applies only to the pilot, not this whole inventory.

Only four explicitly marked atomic funding families are counted. Collateral-first liquidation callbacks, zero-principal keepers, prefunded fixtures and collateralized borrowing are not additional flash lenders.

This read-only page does not load source references, launch collectors, query RPC, alter gates, authorize signing or retry blocked rehearsals. Source paths and line ranges are plain-text provenance only.

Chain tags describe inventoried scopes, not equal support for every token or chain variant. Unspecified-chain research is not attributed to invented deployments. This inventory is comprehensive for the supplied families, not every possible DeFi route.
